body.zh-Hant: 胡安·包蒂斯塔·佩雷斯1869年12月20日生於加拉加斯，是律師與法官。他約在1895年畢業於中央大學，先在比亞德庫拉執業，1900年返回加拉加斯進入司法界，一路升到聯邦暨最高法院（Corte Federal y de Casación）院長，時間在1929年。
body.en: Juan Bautista Pérez was born in Caracas on 20 December 1869 and was a lawyer and magistrate. He graduated from the Central University around 1895 and practised first in Villa de Cura. He returned to Caracas in 1900, entered the judiciary and rose to the presidency of the Federal and Cassation Court in 1929.

body.zh-Hant: 1929年4月19日戈麥斯重新當選，佩雷斯以聯邦法院院長身分代理總統。國會代表團請戈麥斯再任一屆，在議員堅持下，戈麥斯提名佩雷斯為候選人。1929年5月30日佩雷斯成為憲法總統。同年10月11日他簽署命令驅逐巴倫西亞主教；1930年委內瑞拉還清全部外債。
body.en: On 19 April 1929 Gómez was re-elected, and Pérez took charge of the presidency in his capacity as head of the Federal Court. A congressional delegation asked Gómez to accept another term; at the legislators' insistence, Gómez then proposed Pérez as candidate. On 30 May 1929 Pérez became constitutional president. On 11 October 1929 he signed the decree expelling the bishop of Valencia, and in 1930 Venezuela paid off its entire external debt.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年6月國會指責佩雷斯應為經濟大蕭條負責，他被迫於6月13日辭職。他隨後出任駐西班牙與葡萄牙全權公使（1931至1933年）。1936年2月14日事件後他被驅逐，住在巴塞隆納與巴黎，1939年返國，退出政治。他的財產於1949年發還。
body.en: In June 1931 Congress held Pérez responsible for the depression, and he was forced to resign on 13 June 1931. He was then named minister plenipotentiary in Spain and Portugal (1931 to 1933). After the events of 14 February 1936 he was expelled, lived in Barcelona and Paris, and returned in 1939, retired from politics. His property was restored to him in 1949.

body.zh-Hant: 德海爾1870年12月14日生於格羅寧根，父親是荷蘭改革宗牧師。他在烏得勒支修習法律，1895年以論文取得學位，並成為基督教歷史派報紙《De Nederlander》的編輯。1901年他進入鹿特丹市議會，從此展開政治生涯。
body.en: Dirk Jan de Geer was born in Groningen on 14 December 1870, the son of a Dutch Reformed minister. He studied law at Utrecht and took his degree with a thesis in 1895, and he became an editor of the Christian-Historical daily De Nederlander. In 1901 he entered the Rotterdam municipal council, which began his political career.

heading.en: Parliament, local office and first term as finance minister

body.zh-Hant: 德海爾自1907年11月4日起擔任眾議院議員，並於1908年2月11日至1920年5月8日任南荷蘭省常設委員。1920年5月8日他出任阿納姆市長，1921年7月28日改任財政大臣。他在1923年8月11日卸任，傳記稱他是為抗議恢復審議艦隊法草案而辭職。
body.en: De Geer sat in the Tweede Kamer from 4 November 1907 and was a member of the Zuid-Holland provincial executive from 11 February 1908 to 8 May 1920. He became mayor of Arnhem on 8 May 1920 and Minister of Finance on 28 July 1921. He left that post on 11 August 1923, resigning, according to the biography, in protest against the resumed debate on the draft Naval Act.

heading.zh-Hant: 首次出任首相與財政大臣
heading.en: First premiership and the Finance portfolio

body.zh-Hant: 1925年8月4日德海爾出任內政暨農業大臣。1926年3月8日他組成首個內閣並兼任財政大臣，直到1929年8月8日；之後他留任財政大臣，至1933年5月26日。這段期間他與同僚完成《財政關係法》，設立市鎮基金。
body.en: On 4 August 1925 De Geer became Minister of the Interior and Agriculture. On 8 March 1926 he formed his first cabinet and kept Finance, serving as chairman of the council of ministers until 8 August 1929, and he stayed on as Finance minister until 26 May 1933. In those years he and a colleague produced the Financial Relations Act, which created the municipal fund.

heading.zh-Hant: 基督教歷史聯盟領袖與第二任內閣
heading.en: CHU leader and the second cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 1933年德海爾出任基督教歷史聯盟黨主席，任期自11月29日至1939年8月10日。1939年8月10日他再度組閣並兼任財政大臣。傳記稱1940年5月10日他的世界觀完全崩塌；同年他隨內閣撤往倫敦。他於1940年9月3日卸任，傳記指出女王迫使他辭職。
body.en: In 1933 De Geer became chairman of the Christian-Historical Union, serving from 29 November 1933 to 10 August 1939. On 10 August 1939 he formed his second cabinet and also held Finance. According to the biography his world view collapsed completely on 10 May 1940; that year he left for London with his cabinet. His term ended on 3 September 1940, after the queen forced him to resign.

body.zh-Hant: 特別法庭於1947年5月23日作出判決；同年10月29日，特別上訴法院判處德海爾一年徒刑緩刑，他的國務大臣頭銜於1947年11月12日被剝奪。他在1960年11月27日於松斯特去世。
body.en: The Special Court gave its sentence on 23 May 1947; on 29 October 1947 the Special Court of Cassation sentenced De Geer to one year, suspended, and his title of minister of state was taken from him on 12 November 1947. He died in Soest on 27 November 1960.

body.zh-Hant: 紀堯姆四世1852年4月22日生於威斯巴登近郊的比布里希宮，是拿騷公爵阿道夫與阿德爾海德·瑪麗的長子。1866年普魯士併吞拿騷公國，公爵家族被迫離開故地；他於1867年9月進入德勒斯登的薩克森士官學校，1871年10月17日通過軍官考試，加入奧地利軍隊，1884年升上校並指揮第一驃騎兵團。
body.en: Guillaume IV was born on 22 April 1852 at Biebrich Palace near Wiesbaden, the eldest son of Duke Adolphe of Nassau and Adelheid Marie. After Prussia annexed Nassau in 1866 the ducal family was forced to leave; in September 1867 he entered the Saxon cadet school in Dresden, passed his officer examination on 17 October 1871 and joined the Austrian army, becoming a colonel in 1884 with command of the 1st Hussar Regiment.

body.zh-Hant: 1884年起他準備成為盧森堡王儲，1890年父親阿道夫登上大公之位。他與信奉天主教的瑪麗亞·安娜·布拉干薩的婚事爭議多年，直到1893年阿道夫才同意，婚禮於1893年6月21日在菲施霍恩城堡舉行。夫婦共有六個女兒。
body.en: From 1884 he prepared for the role of crown prince, and in 1890 his father Adolphe became grand duke. His marriage to the Catholic Maria Anna of Braganza was disputed for years, and Adolphe gave consent only in 1893; the wedding was held at Fischhorn Castle on 21 June 1893. The couple had six daughters.

body.zh-Hant: 1905年11月22日議會代表團在霍恩堡城堡聽取他的就職宣誓。他在同年再度中風，身體逐漸癱瘓。他以修改家族公約確認長女瑪麗－阿德萊德的繼承地位，廢除了薩利克繼承法；1908年妻子瑪麗亞·安娜宣誓出任攝政。他於1912年2月25日去世。
body.en: On 22 November 1905 a delegation of the Chamber of Deputies took his oath at Hohenbourg Castle. In the same year he suffered another stroke that began a progressive paralysis. By amending the Family Pact he confirmed his eldest daughter Marie-Adélaïde as heir, ending the Salic law of succession, and in 1908 his wife Maria Anna was sworn in as regent. He died on 25 February 1912.
